posts.title: Welcome to OCG Network
posts.author: Apathy
posts.html:
CarbonCraft is now OCG Survival, the first server on OCG Network: one home for every Minecraft server we run at OverCrafted Games. The switch is done and the server is open.

Your world, items, claims, money and friends are all right where you left them.

What's new

  • New address: play.ocgames.xyz takes you to the network lobby, where you pick a server. On Java, play.carboncraft.xyz still takes you straight to Survival.
  • One store for every server: https://minecraft.ocgames.xyz/store
  • Network ranks: buy once, keep it for good, use it on every OCG server.
  • OCG+: a monthly loot drop of Credits and crate keys, on every server.
  • Credits: the network currency. One balance you can spend anywhere.

Coming from CarbonCraft?

  • CarbonCoins are now Credits. Your balance moved over 1:1. Check it with /credits and see every purchase with /credits history. The coin packs are the same, at the same prices. Need to move Credits to a friend? Ask staff and they'll set it up.
  • Carbon+ (1, 3 or 6 months) keeps every perk until the time you paid for runs out. The Carbon+ chat tag is retired, and it won't renew as OCG+, so pick an OCG+ tier if you want to carry on.
  • Carbon+ Lifetime holders now have Radiant, our top network rank, free and permanent on every server. It's already on your account.
  • Crate keys haven't changed. Your keys and crates kept the same names.

Something look wrong since the switch? Ask us here in Discord and we'll sort it.
